intent: A kit Card that tilts a few degrees toward the pointer with a soft highlight, for rare showcase spots (a pricing highlight, a docs gallery). Wraps Card; never the default Card.
useWhen: one highlighted plan or feature in a showcase
a docs or marketing gallery tile
doNotUseWhen: dense data UI: tables, forms, agent monitors
every card in a grid; keep it to one or two

inherits.note: Takes every Card prop (title, description, children, size, actions, headerAction, flush, imageSrc, imageAlt) and passes it through.

tilt.note: false keeps the hover lift only.

maxTilt.note: Degrees at the card's edge, capped at 6.

disabled.note: Mutes the content, sets aria-disabled, no tilt or lift.

motion.hover: rotateX/rotateY ≤ maxTilt toward the pointer; a shadow.md layer fades in; a highlight follows the pointer
motion.leave: eases back to rest over motion.duration400
motion.reducedMotion: no rotate and no highlight; hover lifts the shadow only

requirements: the tilt is pointer-only (mouse, pen); touch does nothing
keyboard focus inside shows a focus ring and a static lift, never a tilt

doNot: Do not invent a local HoverCard or 3D card
Do not tilt more than 6 degrees
